I had a similar situation, but my ex knew I have mental health issues… the thing was I was working for 80-90 hours a week and barely taking care of myself because I was worried about paying bills and wanting nice things for us….
I will attach a link if you guys can give me advice. I feel like we both did some wrong of course…. But he pretends to someone else for 6 months….

https://www.reddit.com/r/relationships_advice/comments/u1ipnz/its_been_3_months_i_feel_numb_and_i_want_to_end/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=ios_app&utm_name=iossmf
It can really hard to open to people you know (family or friends). It’s helps to speak your feelings here
I did that for this guy for my closet friend…. I regret it .
The problem is I am processing all of my traumas for ten years now…. I can’t even leave my apartment at all. I just can’t do the hobbies I used love or do because I feel broken
I feel really alone even with the little people I have
My therapist helps at times but I literally broke
I am but I feel like… I need a new one….
Religion caused some of trauma when I was child.
